keyFindings.description: sweepStaleQueue awaits between entries; expireLinger (outside the lane) can promote the next stale entry in that window, so with two or more stale entries at once the log effect could claim a drop for an entry that was promoted. Needs two or more stale entries the boot sweep did not clear plus a linger expiring in the window; pre-change code promoted every stale entry. Optional hardening: staleQueueEntryReason(...) === undefined in advancePromotionSweep candidate filter.

removeQueued deletes a queued record whose worker claims may survive a launch-failed -> todo -> done chain (admit() does not touch state.roles). Every claim path guards the tree lookup; claims are stale either way.
